## Flow

```mermaid title="Request flow" lineNumbers startLine=8
flowchart TD
    accTitle: Documentation request
    accDescr: A document is written, previewed, and published.
    A[Write Markdown] --> B[Preview]
    B --> C{Ready?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Publish]
    C -->|No| A
```

## Sequence

```mermaid title="Request sequence"
sequenceDiagram
    Reader->>Site: Open documentation
    Site-->>Reader: Return the document
```
